retrace-fail.title: The retracement never came
retrace-fail.lesson: Retracement trades work best right after a strong HTF VR; skip them when the HTF move is still impulsive.

hunt.title: Right idea, stopped out first
hunt.lesson: Put the stop past the next swing or the liquidity just beyond the CF, or wait for the sweep before entering.

leftmoney.title: Target left money on the table
leftmoney.lesson: Consider holding part of the position for the next target.

reversal.title: The market turned for real
reversal.lesson: Valid loss: the stop did its job. Nothing to fix unless this setup keeps doing it.

besaved.title: Break-even saved a loss
besaved.lesson: The break-even rule protected this one.

late.title: Late entry
late.lesson: Take signals within the first few candles after the CF.

against.title: Against the D1 trend
against.lesson: Favour trades with the D1 trend, or demand more reward:risk against it.

gaveback.title: Gave back the profit
gaveback.lesson: Move the stop to break-even or take a partial at +1R.

normal.title: Normal loss
normal.lesson: An accepted cost of trading. Count it, don't change the rules for it.

gap.title: Price gapped through the stop
gap.lesson: Gaps happen at reopens and on news; size so a gap is survivable.
